extracted.name: Butter Beef
extracted.description: This 3-ingredient butter beef recipe is easy to make in your slow cooker with cubed beef, butter, and onion soup mix for a comforting dinner.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) envelope dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Place beef and butter in a slow cooker. Sprinkle onion soup mix over top.
Cover, and cook until meat is tender, on Low for 8 hours, or on High for 4 to 5 hours. Stir once or twice during cook time.
